metaTitle: Custom Flame Resistant Outerwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom flame resistant outerwear for your team. Perfect for safety managers and bulk buyers. Shop at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Flame resistant outerwear is essential for workers in welding, electrical, and oil & gas industries where arc flash or flash fire hazards are present. Unlike standard work jackets, these garments are engineered with inherently FR fabrics or treated cotton that self-extinguish when exposed to flames. Adding your company logo via heat-seal or embroidery maintains the FR rating while reinforcing your safety culture. Choose from parkas, vests, and rainwear in hi-vis options for maximum protection on the job site.
heroAltText: Custom flame resistant outerwear with reflective stripes and embroidered logo for industrial safety
